summary_en: ¥1.0 billion upper limit; 1,100,000 shares (2.09% of ex-treasury S/O); open-market purchase (投資一任方式); execution window Aug 10 2026–Mar 31 2027. Rationale: responsive capital policy, shareholder return, capital-efficiency enhancement.
